events.what: Spanish municipal elections (all town and city councils) and elections to this community's regional parliament, Sunday 23 May 2027: the law sets them for the fourth Sunday of May every four years, unless a regional president with the power to dissolve calls an earlier election.
events.effect: Election day; a day of reflection beforehand. Not yet formally called: the call is issued by decree about 54 days before.

sources.title: Ley Organica 5/1985 del Regimen Electoral General
sources.supports: fourth-Sunday-of-May rule for local and regional elections (read directly); the 2027 date is calculated from it

laws.rule: At Monte Arabí Natural Monument, the regional authority says fires are prohibited and there are no permitted camping areas.

laws.rule: At Monte Arabí, the regional authority says summit access is restricted from 1 November through 31 July for breeding birds. Check current site notices before visiting.
laws.heading: Monte Arabí visitor guidance

laws.rule: In Sierra Espuña Regional Park, the regional authority says camping is allowed only in prepared areas with the corresponding authorisation. Fires are prohibited except at authorised places and times.
